title: Do we need history.js?
body:
We are using https://github.com/mjackson/history internally to sync our search state to the url. I am not sure this is entirerly needed.

Investigate if:

* we need it?
* does it leaks to the public API (url sync doc and code)?

In instantsearch.js v1 we used two methods from the browser history API and it worked perfectly. Also we do not need to support hash based url state now (history API starts at IE11 which is OK for react-instantsearch).
